name: decision-engine-js
description: Fast local structured decisions for Node.js, Bun, and the web

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/node build && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.test:training: uv run --project conversion python -m unittest discover -s training -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/node typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck && tsc -p apps/demo/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate:data: python3 training/validate.py training/example.jsonl && python3 training/validate.py training/department.jsonl
scripts.export:trained: uv run --project conversion conversion/export_onnx.py --checkpoint models/laya-finetuned --output models/laya-finetuned-onnx
scripts.demo: bun run build && bun run apps/demo/server.ts
scripts.benchmark: bun run build && bun run apps/benchmark.ts
